Letter of Recommendation
Our ref: 60
March 31, 2026
This office has engaged M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for the work “Material Handling Plant
— Madhya Pradesh Pkg-68” (INR 43,42,00,000/-), completed on January 8, 2013. On the basis of that
engagement we record the following:
Adherence to the sanctioned programme of work and milestone dates;
Quality of workmanship accepted at inspection without material objection;
Compliance with safety and statutory obligations on site;
Responsiveness of the contractor's site management.
We confirm that National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. executed the referenced work to our satisfaction.
Their performance on schedule, quality, and safety was commendable.
Verification: Vikram Chopra, ee@dept.gov.in, +91-9830000000.
